column1: # ZAP scan rules for tests/security/zap-baseline.sh and zap-api.sh — tab-separated: <rule id> <action> <rule name>
# Actions: IGNORE (accepted, reason above the line), INFO, WARN (default for rules not listed), FAIL (exit code 1).
# Every IGNORE/INFO needs a reason and the date. Triage of 2026-11-13 (frontend = Vite dev server, gateway = docker).
# 40018 on POST /api/auth/login (password), 2026-11-13: FALSE POSITIVE. The boolean pair "' AND '1'='1' --" /
# "' AND '1'='2' --" got different answers only because the scan's failed logins tripped identity-service's account
# lockout (UserAccount.lockedUntil): after it even the correct password answers 401 "temporarily locked", while the
# first, un-injected request had answered 200. Passwords are BCrypt-checked in Java after a JPA lookup by e-mail (no
# native SQL). Verified by hand with curl. SQL injection still FAILs on every other URL.
# --- Kept as WARN on purpose (not accepted: fix them where the production frontend is served, Phase 14) -----------
# 10038 CSP header not set, 10020 anti-clickjacking header missing, 10021 X-Content-Type-Options missing,
# 10063 Permissions-Policy not set — on the frontend. The Vite dev server sends no security headers; the gateway sends
# X-Frame-Options/X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy already. The built frontend (CloudFront/nginx) must add
# Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors 'none'), X-Content-Type-Options, Permissions-Policy.
# 90004 COEP/COOP/CORP missing: cross-origin isolation is not wanted — the SPA embeds OpenStreetMap tiles and the
# Razorpay checkout script, which `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp` would block. Low. 2026-11-13.
# 10096 Timestamp disclosure: the "timestamps" are epoch-ms fields and numeric ids in API payloads (e.g. iat_ms,
# order times) that the client is meant to read. False positive. 2026-11-13.
# 10024 "token" in URL: http://<frontend>/?token=… is the Vite dev server's HMR websocket token (dev only, not a
# credential of the platform; a production build has no HMR). 2026-11-13.
# 10027 suspicious comments: comments in the unminified modules the Vite dev server serves (/src/**, /@react-refresh);
# a production build strips them. 2026-11-13.
# 10109 modern web application / 10049 cache directives: informational. API responses are `no-store` (correct); the
# dev server's dependency bundles are cacheable (correct). 2026-11-13.
# 100000 4xx answers / 10111 authentication request / 10112 session management response: informational — the API
# scan sends unauthorised and malformed requests on purpose and the API answers 400/401/403/404/409/422 ProblemDetails
# without stack traces (rule 90022 Application Error Disclosure passed). 2026-11-13.
